rule.statement: The High Court erred when it rejected an affidavit on the ground that it is not clear if the contents of the affidavit have been read over to the deponent or whether the deponent read the contents himself.
rule.supporting_quote: I am therefore of the view that the High Court erred when it rejected the affidavit on the ground that it is not clear if the contents of the affidavit have been read over to the deponent or whether the deponent read the contents himself.
rule.statute_citation_verbatim: Section 14A of the Civil Procedure Code
